T1053.long: Utilities such as at and schtasks, along with the Windows Task Scheduler, can be used to schedule programs or scripts to be executed at a date and time. A task can also be scheduled on a remote system, provided the proper authentication is met to use RPC and file and printer sharing is turned on. Scheduling a task on a remote system typically required being a member of the Administrators group on the the remote system.

strings: Our company is a Export PPE Service company, mainly for high visibility clothing and protective gloves. And also do shipping agent,so our price is quite competitive.

Nowdays our Hi Vis clothing partner the daily production capacity is more than 20,000pcs safety vests, 5,000pcs T-shirts, and 2,000pcs jackets and established in house test lab for testing all the material, for example high visibility fabric fluorescent, the reflective tape luminance, water proof, fire resistant and so on.

We accept customized / OEM order.
Hope we can be partners in the near future.
